notes.title: Proxima Divide v0.3.3
notes.notes:
[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Expanded world layout: next area now partially explorable (no gameplay yet)
[*] Procedural building workflow implemented, allowing placement of buildings of any size
[*] Early interior work started for new areas
[*] Robots now perform ambient tasks (cleaning, maintenance, moving boxes) before detecting the player
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where pickaxe prompt showed incorrect slot
[*] Crash site fire now extinguishes after the first night
[*] Fixed item drop-through-floor issue (especially affecting pistol)
[*] Added drop sound effect for pistol (other items will receive sounds in future updates)
[/list]

Read more about it on the blog: [url=https://proximadivide.com/?p=219]https://proximadivide.com/?p=219[/url]

notes.title: Proxima Divide v0.3.0
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Save Slots Added – Players can now create and manage multiple save files.
[*] Pause Menu Save/Load – Save and load your progress directly from the pause menu.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed eating animations for sprats and sardines.
[*] Adjusted terrain for smoother navigation and improved visuals.
[*] Addressed saving issues and improved reliability.
[*] Fixed visibility of player character during cutscenes.
[*] Addressed several crashes and softlocks.
[/list]
[h1]Upcoming Changes[/h1]
The hovering drone enemy is being replaced by a new bipedal robot – more grounded, tactical, and visually striking.

[url=https://proximadivide.com/?p=130]Read more about it in our Dev Log[/url]

notes.title: Proxima Divide is Now in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[p]We’re excited to announce that [b]Proxima Divide[/b], developed by solo indie studio [b]Emberline Studios[/b], is now available on Steam in Early Access![/p][p align="start"]🪐 [b]About the Game[/b]
Enter a fractured alien world where survival depends on your ability to mine, craft, and adapt. With a rich sci-fi atmosphere and immersive gameplay, Proxima Divide invites you to uncover the mysteries of a lost colony—one mission at a time.[/p][p align="start"]🛠️ [b]What’s Included Right Now[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]30–60 minutes of gameplay[/b] featuring the Prologue and the first third of Act 1[/p][/*][*][p]A layered crafting system with raw materials, refined components, and tools[/p][/*][*][p]Built in [b]Unreal Engine[/b], with audio powered by [b]Wwise[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]📅 [b]Development Timeline[/b]
Production began in [b]March 2025[/b], and we’re aiming for a full release in [b]Q1 2027[/b]. We’ll be expanding the game with new missions, systems, and polish—driven by your feedback.[/p][p align="start"]💬 [b]Join the Journey[/b]
Follow our dev log, share your thoughts, and help shape the future of Proxima Divide.
🔗 [url="https://proximadivide.com/"]Website[/url][/p][p align="start"]🙏 [b]Thank You[/b]
To everyone who playtested, wishlisted, and supported the game—this launch is just the beginning.[/p][p align="start"]— Emberline Studios[/p]
